selection: First matching common-test row for each fixed target/camera; no quality-based selection

inputs.scene_rgb: Observed single RGB image, native PNG byte copy
inputs.scene_depth: Metric depth visualization only: fixed 2.5–3.5 m, near white/far black; nonfinite or nonpositive pixels black; this display inversion is not model preprocessing
inputs.target_reference: Standalone center reference; segmentation-bbox crop with 18% padding, aspect-preserving 320-square thumbnail; not model preprocessing

display.complexity_units: Regional multi-object support score; neither probability nor integer object count; 6 is only the display ceiling
display.predictions: Float32 30x40 predictions -> cv2.INTER_LINEAR 640x480 -> optional O workspace -> floor(clip(value/ceiling,0,1)*255+0.5)
display.native_gt: Existing 640x480 grayscale PNGs copied byte-for-byte; S/C numeric training GT remains pooled float NPZ
display.occlusion_postprocess: Main prediction multiplies the existing binary fixed-camera workspace after float expansion; raw prediction is also included; no target GT/GT coverage mask applied

limitations: Independent S/O/C streams; fusion is untrained. Fusion PNGs are amodal target GT only.
These five predetermined examples are illustrations, not a new performance evaluation.
Raw predictions, checkpoints, GT and recorded evaluation metrics are unchanged.
O evaluation used raw 30x40 outputs and GT coverage; the published workspace postprocessing does not revise those metrics.
Visible-pixel Similarity and Complexity GT are distinct from the amodal fusion target mask.

provenance.prediction_arrays: Existing completion SHA recorded; complete prediction arrays not rehashed during export

depth.brightness: near white, far black; fixed shared range, not per-image normalization
